question: In June 2025, a stampede occurred near which stadium in Bengaluru?
solution:
The correct answer is __**M Chinnaswamy Stadium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **M Chinnaswamy Stadium**, located in the heart of Bengaluru, Karnataka, is one of India’s premier cricket stadiums. It has hosted numerous national and international cricket matches.
 
• In **June 2025**, the stadium was the site of a tragic stampede that occurred near its premises during a major event, possibly due to overcrowding and mismanagement of crowds.
 
• The stadium was established in **1969** and has a seating capacity of approximately **40,000**, making it a significant venue for large-scale sporting events and concerts.
 
• It is named after **Mangalam Chinnaswamy**, a former president of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), in recognition of his contributions to Indian cricket.
 
• The location of the stadium, in the bustling city of Bengaluru, often sees heavy traffic and large gatherings, which may have contributed to the unfortunate incident in **2025**.
